plugin.name: business-os
plugin.description: Read and update the user's own business records — contacts, invoices, bookings, tasks and services
plugin.context: The user's own Business OS data, held in this product rather than an external service. Use it to answer questions about their business and to act on their own records. Nothing needs connecting: this is their data, already here. Combine it with other plugins to move information between their business and outside services.
